facts: MCP.add writes an in-memory overrides Map then state.reload; enabled add can start a process/network connection. Registration must deliberately use disabled:true if connect is a separate explicit action.

MCP.connect stops then starts the selected registered server under a server lock. MCP.disconnect stops it then reports disabled and publishes StatusChanged. SDK void ACK alone proves neither connected state nor exact child process exit.
MCP.remove stores false in runtime overrides and reloads. No file persistence follows solely from this API.
